title: UMB supports total employee wellness through well-being and financial health initiatives
summary: UMB prioritizes associates’ personal and financial health with programs designed for the well-being of our diverse and talented employees.
body_markdown:
At UMB, we prioritize our associates’ personal and financial health with programs designed for the well-being and support of our diverse and talented employees.


Our robust benefits program includes medical, vision and dental insurance, health savings and flexible savings accounts, a 401(k) retirement plan with a matching contribution program, and a profit-sharing plan that features an employee stock ownership plan — but that’s not all. We have additional initiatives employees have access to that can improve their overall health.


Below we share some details on our associate wellness, health and well-being programs.


## Work-Life balance


We believe our work is an important part of associates’ lives, alongside many other passions — family, community involvement, health and fitness, time off for relaxation and more.


Employees are encouraged to create a healthy[work/life balance](https://blog.umb.com/umb-financial-associate-profile-riana-maus/) by utilizing a minimum of 20 paid time off days for full time employees per calendar year that scales with your tenure, 16 hours of paid time off to volunteer each year and eight hours of paid time off to use for your physical, fiscal or spiritual wellbeing.


Additionally, UMB provides up to eight weeks of[paid parental leave](https://blog.umb.com/umb-financial-employee-benefits-paid-parental-leave/) at 90% of base pay to eligible associates after six months of service so adoptive and birth parents and legal guardians, have paid time off to care for and bond with a newborn or newly adopted child.


## Wellness and well-being


We strive to make maintaining our team’s physical health a top priority by offering access to a variety of wellness programs and incentives. Eligible associates can receive an annual medical premium incentive of up to $1,000 to help offset insurance premium costs. Spouses and domestic partners of associate can earn the same incentive amount individually (if they are covered on a UMB medical plan) .


Additionally, associates also have $250 per calendar year that can be used for reimbursing fitness-related expenses such as race/wellness event entry fees, weight management programs or fitness center/health membership costs.


We also implemented a fitness tracker subsidy to help make tracking activity to earn incentives a little easier. Additionally, we partner with a well-being platform that offers diverse physical and mental health resources accessible in an app, alongside personalized health goals associates can work toward.


Through our benefits team, we provide associates access to comfortable, private and secure health rooms as required for specific health-related activities and needs during their workday at UMB.


## Financial wellness


Financial wellness is our wheelhouse, which is why we prioritize the financial foundations of our associates through our associate banking program.


This program offers our associates free financial review to help plan financial goals and strategies, special discounts and waivers for investing with UMB, competitive banking solutions, exclusive mortgage origination fee waiver, interest-bearing checking account based on tiered balances, UMB Simply Rewards Visa® credit card with a special interest rate on purchases and discounted brokerage services.


We also have the[UMB Financial Education Center](https://www.umb.com/personal-banking/products-and-services/financial-education) , which provides interactive courses on foundational financial topics. These courses can be customized into a playlist that suits associate financial goals and planning needs.


## **Associate support programs**


When faced with a personal crisis, people sometimes find it difficult to ask their employer for help. At UMB, we want our associates to know we are here to support them in good and bad times. As a result, we offer multiple associate support programs to offer personal or financial assistance to those in need.


Because UMB is committed to the welfare and well-being of each associate, we provide an employee assistance program to all associates. This program is designed to assist associates in coping with family, personal and/or work-related problems. Services provided through this program are strictly confidential and participation is encouraged throughout the year.


To learn more about UMB and our connections to the communities we serve, visit our[community involvement page](https://www.umb.com/about-umb/community) , read our[Corporate Citizenship and ESG Report](https://www.umb.com/about-umb/corporate-citizenship) , and follow us on[Facebook](http://www.facebook.com/UMBBank) ‡ and[LinkedIn](http://www.linkedin.com/company/umbbank) ‡.
